title: Sabé
description: Of Queen Amidala's retinue of most trusted and loyal handmaidens, Sabé was the most important. Able to double the queen in times of crisis, she served as a decoy for any who would try to harm the queen. During the Trade Federation's blockade of Naboo, Sabé took on the more dangerous role of queen, communicating with the actual queen through a complicated series of signals.
